edbDesc: The process where individual molecules flow through a hole without collisions between molecules. This occurs if the diameter of the hole is considerably smaller than the mean free path of the molecules.
title: Effusion
pickWhy: Graham's law of effusion (gas leaking through a pinhole, lighter gases faster) came out of the same Thomas Graham work as the Diffusion card; it is the basis of uranium enrichment by gaseous diffusion.
